transcript: AI: Hello, what is your name? Rahul: My name is Rahul. AI: How old are you? Rahul: I have twenty-two. AI: 'I have twenty-two' nahi, 'I am twenty-two years old' hota hai. [Not 'I have twenty-two', it is 'I am twenty-two years old'.] Rahul: Okay, okay, I am twenty-two years old. AI: Where are you from? Rahul: I am Uttar Pradesh. AI: 'I am Uttar Pradesh' nahi, 'I am from Uttar Pradesh' hoga. [Not 'I am Uttar Pradesh', it should be 'I am from Uttar Pradesh'.] Rahul: Oh theek hai, mujhe English achhe se nahi aati. [Oh okay, I don't know English well.] AI: Koi problem nahi. AI teachers try kiya? [No problem. Did you try AI teachers?] Rahul: Wo to mehnge hote honge na? [They must be expensive, right?] AI: Bilkul nahi, bas 1 rupay ka trial, chai se bhi sasta hai. Isliye lakhon log English Seekho par English seekh rahe hain. [Not at all, just a 1 rupee trial, cheaper than tea. That's why lakhs of people are learning on English Seekho.] Rahul: Par time nahi milta. [But I don't get time.] AI: Roz ki sirf 15 se 20 minute ki practice kaafi hai. Install ka button dabao aur English Seekho app download karo. [Just 15 to 20 minutes of daily practice is enough. Press the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: ME NO ENGLISH. I can't speak English. English Seekho. Install Now.
summary: An AI-generated skit featuring a rural man interacting with an AI avatar on a large screen. The AI corrects his English grammar errors and pitches the English Seekho app as an affordable, judgment-free tool for daily practice. The ad concludes with a call to install the app.
